problem_statement: This stems form an issue where a PyKokkos kernel was passed a non-contiguous numpy array, leading to a segfault. This should be caught on the PyKokkos side.
test_patch:
diff --git a/tests/test_typeinference.py b/tests/test_typeinference.py
index 0193c6b9..d18c31d4 100644
--- a/tests/test_typeinference.py
+++ b/tests/test_typeinference.py
@@ -695,6 +695,12 @@ def test_list_3d_python_list(self):
         expected = sum(sum(sum(row) for row in plane) for plane in python_3d)
         self.assertEqual(result[0], expected)
 
+    def test_numpy_noncontiguous(self):
+        contiguous = np.arange(10)
+        noncontiguous = contiguous[::2]
+        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+            pk.parallel_for(len(noncontiguous), init_view, view=noncontiguous, init=0)
+
